Governing issue: # (phase/milestone; dependency status)

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. State scope, non-goals and risks.

Evidence: exact commands, actual results, negative controls, links/artifacts and
limitations. Record compute estimate, actual charge and remaining shared budget;
Phase 0B uses D-011 (7,200 CPU-s aggregate, <=10 min/job, <=1 GiB/test process,
<=100 MiB generated test scratch). Scientific results: **not yet evaluated**
unless linked experiment evidence supports a narrower claim.

Candidate: head `<full SHA>`; base `<full SHA>`; CI source/merge `<full SHA>`.
Open as draft; draft CI must run. Self-review is complete before independent review.

Review: link fresh-context read-only exact-candidate brief/result, reviewer/model,
risk coverage, checks and limits. Preserve original finding IDs/statements and
explicit dispositions, repair SHAs and focused verification. Do not overwrite
findings with favorable summaries. Follow [WORKFLOW](https://github.com/jaharris87/crucible-astro/blob/main/docs/WORKFLOW.md).

Human handoff: pending decisions and next action/owner. Before readiness/merge,
compare reviewed head/base with actual PR head/base; record checks/review freshness
and resolve consequential findings. A human must explicitly decide merge. After
merge, record merged SHA and integration checks before issue closeout.
